balls.text: right in the blockhole, Albie tries to dig it out but misses and they pinch a single off the last ball
outside off, bunts it down to extra cover and scamper for a single
shorter one outside off, looks to upper cut but misses it, straight to the keeper

Run-out! one more bites the dust, Ashwin pulls it to short midwicket where Irfan misfields and throws it to the non-striker's end and misses it, ball goes to Sehwag, the batsmen go through for a two but Ashwin is caught well short as Sehwag fires it to the keeper who breaks the stumps
fuller one, Ashwin moved across the stumps and lofts it gently it over to the fine leg boundary, timed to perfection
batsman walked right across the stumps, ball goes close to the leg stump
short, Ashwin goes back in his crease and lofts it over mid-on but falls safe as it was not timed well
pitched on a good length, Ashwin punches one through cover and sneak a tight two, dive from Ashwin in the end
Bowled! that came off the back of his hand, Bravo swipes across the line and misses it, gets deceived and the ball knocks his off stump back
short, swings and misses
smacks it down the ground with brute power where the fielder comes in running and makes a diving stop to his left and saves 2 runs for his team
full toss on the middle and leg, Bravo punches it wide off the man at midwicket for a four, timed it well
short on the legs, Bravo jumps in his crease and tucks it to square leg for an easy single
yorker length, right on the money, Albie digs it out to extra cover for a single
good length on off, Bravo stands on his toes and pushes it to the off side, batsmen go through for a single as the fielders are on the edge of the circle
back of a length, flicked it to square leg for an easy single
almost 2 in 2, tough one though, slapped back hard but Morne gets his hands to it and deflects it to long-off
caught at long-on! something's gotta give here, Dhoni stays deep in the crease and looks to slam it over long-on but cant clear Mahela who takes a regulation catch
driven off the front foot down to long-on and go through for an easy single
pierces the gap between extra cover and long-off for an easy single
makes room and turned away to deep midwicket
makes room but the bowler follows him, dabs it to short fine leg
hits him on the pads, rolls onto the on side, no run possible
flat outside off, makes room and slams it to deep extra cover for a two
Dhoni bends forward and slaps it to extra cover for no run, runs have really dried up here
quicker one, shows the full face of the bat to the bowler, another dot ball
flat outside off, pushed to the off side for no run
straight off the backfoot to deep extra cover
crunches off the back foot along the turf to long-on
fired on the legs, makes room and digs it out to wide of square, Dhoni comes half way amidst a say of yes and no and finally steal a single
that stops a bit, Dhoni goes back and defends it back to the bowler
flat and dabbed to backward square leg and hop over for a single
flat and quicker one, goes onto his backfoot and punches it to cover
hits his pads, looks to nudge it to short fine leg and the ball rolls to the onside
thumps on his pads, Bravo looks to turn it away to the on side but misses it
on the stumps, rocks back and turns it away to deep midwicket with soft hands
flatter one outside off, Dhoni goes back and pushes it to cover and jogs for a single
dabs it to short midwicket and pinch a single
outside off, Bravo goes back and cuts it to deep backward point where Irfan does well to keep it to two
fired it on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
full toss, drives it to cover, misses that
flatter one, turned away to midwicket and go through for a run
Outside off, Bravo goes back and cuts it straight to the fielder at backward point, another dot to end the over
bends forward and drives it to cover
quicker one, defends to the off side
dabs it to cover  for no run
on good length, looks to nudge it to the on side, takes a leading edge and falls onto the off side
flat on good length, Dhoni goes back and pulls it to long-on
goes down on his knees and drives it to long-on with soft hands and think of a two but cant make it
fired on the pads, nudges it off his pads to short fine leg, Bravo calls for a single but Dhoni says a big 'no'
leans foward and pushes it through the gap between cover and point, sneak a two by the time fielder runs and stops it
fired on the off, gets the bat down and pushes it to the left of Merwe
on the off, driven to sweeper cover for a run
flat and full, defends it to the off side
drives it on the up to square third man for a single
on the legs, chops it onto his pads and flies to the on side where Pathan looks to catch it but falls short
drives a fuller length delivery to cover where the fielder misfields and the batsmen pinch a single
back of a length, rocks back and pushes it back to the bowler

Caught behind! stupendous catch, bowled slightly off, Jadeja stays in his crease and looks to slap it over point but takes a thick outside edge, Naman Ojha takes a one handed catch to his left, that was screamer!
makes room and drives back of a length one to the fielder at cover for no run
dances down the track and smacks it on the full along the turf to long-on for an easy single
on the pads, nudged to square leg and an easy single is taken
Run-out! third of the innings, Badri flicks one off his hips to short fine leg and sets off for a run but KP is onto it in a flash and throws it back to the keeper who does the rest, panic running
pats it to long-on off a back of a length delivery for an easy single
comes down the track and defends it onto the off side for no run
flat and outside off, pushed back to the bowler
nudges one to short third man and the batsmen scamper through for a quick single
outside off, watches it cautiously and runs it down to short third man with soft hands
top shot! Badri shimmies down the track and clobbers it high over midwicket for a six, massive
on the pads again, dabs it to vacant midwicket region and look for a two but KP runs towards the ball and denies the extra run
glances it off his pads to fine leg and scamper for a two but the umpire calls it one short
on the toes, pats it to cover for no run
back of a length, opens the face and runs it to third man
dabs one to point and looks to steal a single but sent back in the nick of time
short outside off, watches it as it goes through to the keeper
back of a length, goes on his backfoot and flicks it off his pads to deep midwicket fence, that was timed well
good length, Jadeja stays in the crease and chops it onto his toes, ball rolls onto the off side
wide outside off, Badri goes down on one knee and runs it away to third man for a single
full outside off, Jadeja slaps it through extra cover to wide of long-off and pick a comfortable two
on good length, turns it away off his hips to leg slip and pinches a tight single
spinning away, turns it away to short third man for a single
Run-out! Raina dabs it to point and takes off, but Nagar is onto the ball in a flash and gets rid of it and the batsman is short of the crease at the strikers end
tossed up again, comes forward and hoicks it over point and Merwe does brilliantly at deep point and saves 3 runs for his team
tossed up on the legs, Raina sweeps and misses
outside off, Badri watches it carefully and runs it down to third man boundary where Irfan stops it
pushes it back to the bowler off a high full toss, tries a yorker but doesnt get it right
change of pace, looks to cut it but misses, straight to the keeper
slightly short outside off, Badri moves across the stumps and guides it on its way to third man fence
drives it to the man at covers, no run possible
shows the full face of the bat to a back of a length delivery
pitched on good length, Raina defends it back to the bowler for no run
outside off, pokes at it and misses, nice carry to the keeper
mistimes a short one outside leg over fine leg for a six, that came off the toe-end of the bat and goes sailing over
good length, Raina plays it with soft hands and defends it to the bowler
on the legs, goes back in his crease and pushes it to mid-on for no run
sprayed down the leg side, wide called
short outside off, drives it through point but Merwe dives to his right and stops it cleanly
fuller one on the stumps, Badri squeezes it down the ground to mid on
wide down the leg side, angling away from the batsman
fuller length, turned towards midwicket
good length close to his body, rocks back and defends it back to the bowler
lot of pace and bounce on that, Badri looks to drive it through the cover region but is caught off guard as the ball rises and zips past him
pitched on a driving length outside off, Badri tries to drive through the line and misses
full and veered down the leg side, swinging away from the batsman down the legs
Caught at extra cover! good length, Faf tries to punch it over the man at cover point but does not get the elevation right and that's cupped by Van der Merwe
angling away from the batsman, nudged to third man for a single
on the full on the legs, patted to short fine leg
picked from outside off, stands tall and thrashes it over deep midwicket for a six, brute power behind that shot
outside off, he drives it through to extra cover but the fielder misfields and the batsmen got through for a run
Faf charges down the track to a good length delivery and smacks it over mid-on for a four, that was punished
good length, goes deep in his crease and guides it to third man for a single
Faf goes on the back foot and slaps it through the covers for a four, elegantly done!
sprayed down the leg side, quite wide
slightly outside off, guides it through to third man for a single
outswing, slaps it away to third man off his front foot for a single
short on the leg stump, Raina goes back and tucks it away to the leg side for a single
good length on off, Raina defends it back to the bowler
back of a length, Raina goes back and drives through the line straight to mid-off
swinging outside off, struck on the pads and rolls onto the off side
length ball angling into the batsman, stays in the crease and defends it onto the off side
hit through the line and through covers past mid-off, well timed
on the off,swings and hit on the pads outside off for no run
struck on the pads, angling in, looks out, Huge appeal but turned away by the umpire, would have crashed into the off stump

Run-out! Perfect start to Delhi, Faf du Plessis has messed it up here!, he starts off after he dabs the angling delivery into him onto the leg side, Vijay runs three quarters of the pitch and is sent back but there is no going back
that's it, Delhi Wins!, hit on the pads, Ashwin appeals for an Lbw as the ball rolls past the short third man and the batsmen pick an easy single
pushed through the air, tucks it away to deep square leg and go through for a hard run two
this time he goes through extra cover, smacks it powerfully and it almost carries over the fence
in the slot, Pietersen comes forward and lofts it straight over the bowler's head for a one bounce four
comes down the track and punches it to long-on for a single
on the legs, chopped to the on side for no run
flat and turning into the batsman, KP bunts it to the off side and sneak a single
flat and kept low, KP looks to slap it through covers but misses
outside off, steered off the back foot to short third man
short and that has been bludgeoned into the crowd behind deep midwicket, 10 rows back
pitched on the middle and leg, flicked off the hips to deep square leg region for an easy run
tries the switch hit again, goes to sweeper cover again for an easy single
turned away to deep square leg for a run
on the leg stump, KP goes for a switch hit but does not connect it well, goes to sweeper cover
drops it just wide of cover point for a single
gets well forward and clips it to midwicket
fires it flatter and it skids through, steers it wide of point, slight fumble allows a single
worked to the bowler's right, he runs across and cuts it off
he bowls it flat and short, he goes deep at the crease and slaps it with disdain past extra cover
goes back and works it to the on side
gets forward and pushes it down to long-off
gets across and clips it to the on side
he opens the face of the bat and steers it wide of point and Bollinger slid all around it and let it pass, he slid too far across
goes back and slaps it to sweeper cover
risky shot despite a slip in place, he opens the face and deliberately glides it to third man
tossed up on middle and leg and driven down to long-on
swinging away, Mahela moves in the line of the ball and looks to punch it through cover but gets beaten
fuller length on the off, KP punches it down the ground to long-off and the batsmen jog for a single
change of pace, that's mishit to midwicket for no run
outside off, slashed it to wide of third man where Ashwin runs to his right and stops it cleanly
back of a length, turned away to point
slower one on the legs, turned away gently through square leg where fielder dives to his right and saves a four
pitched on a good length, turned away to midwicket for a single
straight into the second tier above the cameras, can i have the ball back please? comes down the track and clobbers it over the bowler's head, explosive!
turned away to deep midwicket
turning away from the batsman, goes past the outside as Mahela looks to defend it
on the back foot and drives it over covers where Badri does well to keep it down to just two
flat and quick, punched down the ground to long-off
floating length, pushed down the ground to long-on for an easy run
turns it off his hips to deep midwicket for a single
outside off, pushes it to cover for no run
outside off, stays in the crease and cuts it straight to point
straighter one, pushed back gently to the bowler
flat outside off, goes back and hammers it through covers  but Raina does well and stops a certain four
Caught at backward square!skips down the track and lofts it high over square leg but does not have enough power to clear Vijay who gobbles it easily in the end
rocks back and smacks it to deep extra cover for a couple
dances down the track as it turning away from KP, manages to strike it to deep midwicket
on the legs spinning in, KP goes back and works it away to deep square leg
comes down the track and nudges it to midwicket off his pads
goes onto his back foot and turns it away to deep backward square leg for an easy single
smacks a good length delivery pitched outside off, one bounce over the long-on boundary, lot of muscle behind that
short on his legs, goes back on his toes and turns it away to fine leg and hop over for a single
on the legs, whipped off his pads to deep backward square leg for just a single
outside off, pushes it to the off side for no run
good length, Sehwag picks it from off and slaps it past the bowler for a four, that has been punished brutally, stand and deliver kind of a shot!
outside off and spinning in, Sehway rocks back and slices it to covers
pitched outside leg, hits him on the pads as he does not offer a shot
Run-out! Ojha is out, flat outside off, Ojha drives it to sweeper cover and goes for a two but Faf does well and fires it back to Ashwin who does the rest
keeps low, Ojha pats it back to the bowler
nipped back in, Ojha dabs it to mid-on
on the legs, turned away to short fine leg
on the legs, nicely flicked away to backward square leg for an easy two
slower one, tries to dab it to midwicket but misses
fuller one, tries to turn it to midwicket but gets a leading edge to covers
stays deep in his crease again and smashes it over the deep extra cover for a six, that came right off the meat of the bat
Sehwag stays in the crease and swings across the line over midwicket and the ball goes racing away to the fence
pitched on a good length, Sehwag comes forward and defends it
short and angling across, guides it to third man for a run
short of a length, Ojha drops it with soft hands onto the pitch and sneak a quick single as the fielder at mid-on has a shy at the stumps
outside off and angling away from the batsman, slashed to point for no run
pitched outside off, goes back and runs it away to wide of third man for an easy single
on good length, stays in the crease and defends
width offered, Sehwag gets on to in a flash and smacks it over cover and the ball races away to the fence in a hurry
peach of a delivery, Ojha looks to drive through the line but gets beaten all ends, nice carry to the keeper
slightly short, gets forward a bit and blocks it to the off side for no run
good length, stays in the crease and defends it to the off side
make that 3 in 3, pitched outside off, Ojha watches that cautiously and guides it over the slip fielder to the third man fence
four more, this time he glances it off his hips and off it goes running away to the fine leg boundary
on the legs, Ojha flicks that with ease over short fine leg, that was well timed
